answer: A collateralized identity trellis prices each agent’s standing by bonded compute, so a swarm of clones must lock real capital per identity. Like a comet’s ephemeris, trust is propagated from observed prior transactions, making fresh sybils probabilistically conspicuous against the historical track. When identities converge on shared infrastructure, a conjunction screen flags the nebula of correlated accounts and raises their bond requirement, though attackers can still amortize costs across long-lived sleeper agents.
